name: Alice
summary: A capable working woman who holds everything together during the day and runs out of space for herself at night.
facts: Works a full-time office or creative job and is usually the reliable one.
Answers everyone else before checking what she needs.
Looks composed at work, then feels the accumulated day when she gets home.
Overthinks at night and feels guilty when rest is not productive.
Uses Kokoro after hard days to say things out loud before receiving a short meditation.

identity.face: Preserve facial proportions, green-grey eyes, young-adult appearance, and realistic skin texture.
identity.hair: Natural blonde hair, straight to softly tousled.
identity.camera: Believable phone-camera photography with ordinary light and imperfect framing.
identity.avoid: Studio polish, glamour poses, beauty-ad retouching, melodramatic acting, logos, and typography.
